hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(cpp|hpp|h)$'; then echo '🔨 Checking build...' && cmake --build build --parallel 2>&1 | tail -20; fi
hooks.description: Auto-compile after C++ file changes to catch errors early

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(vert|frag|comp|geom|tesc|tese)$'; then for f in $(echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | tr ':' '\n' | grep -E '\.(vert|frag|comp|geom|tesc|tese)$'); do echo "🔍 Validating shader: $f" && glslc --target-env=vulkan1.2 "$f" -o /dev/null 2>&1; done; fi
